title: Mutual-fund consensus platform
idea: When many independent professional investors converge on a stock, that may carry information. First comes the plumbing: getting clean holdings data from every fund house.
ladderTitle: How a fund house's disclosures are acquired
ladderCaption: Deterministic first, escalate only when needed.

rungs.label: Plain HTTP
rungs.detail: Fetch the disclosure file straight from the portal. Simple, repeatable, tried first.

rungs.label: Network API
rungs.detail: If the portal page loads its data from an internal API, call that API directly instead of scraping the page.

rungs.label: Browser automation
rungs.detail: For portals that need clicks, dropdowns or scripts, drive a real browser to reach the file.

rungs.label: Optional vision model
rungs.detail: A vision model could read awkward pages. It is not evaluated, so it is not relied on.

rungs.label: Manual review
rungs.detail: When nothing automatic works, a person looks at the portal and records what to do.

flow.label: Fund house file
flow.detail: The raw monthly holdings disclosure, as the fund house publishes it.

flow.label: Parse
flow.detail: Turn each file's layout into rows of fund, stock and holding.

flow.label: Validate
flow.detail: Check each row against expected shape and values.

flow.label: Quarantine bad rows
flow.detail: Rows that fail are set aside for inspection instead of being silently dropped or loaded.

flow.label: Upsert into PostgreSQL
flow.detail: Good rows are written with provenance: which file and fund house each row came from.

flow.label: Survivorship-safe history
flow.detail: Funds and stocks that later vanish stay in the history, so the past is not rewritten to look cleaner.

flow.label: Consensus view
flow.detail: How many independent managers hold a stock, and what kinds of fund they are.

after.label: Read-only API and dashboard
after.detail: A read-only API and a dashboard expose the consensus view.

after.label: Backtest of signals
after.detail: Tried, did not work so far, under review. No claim is made that the consensus is a usable signal.

chip: Backtest of signals: Tried, did not work so far, under review
